name: form-8k
description: Drafts SEC Form 8-K current reports with item-accurate narratives, exhibit indexing, and EDGAR-ready formatting. Use when a public company must disclose a reportable event (material agreement, acquisition, personnel change, Reg FD disclosure) or file a current report within four business days. Trigger on "Form 8-K", "current report", "8-K filing", "EDGAR", "Item 1.01", "Item 2.01", "Item 5.02", "Reg FD".
